participants.description: Random pseudonymous code (P-XXXXXX) shown to the participant. Not derived from any personal data.
Hash of the random secret in the participant's cookie / recovery code. The secret itself is never stored.
Withdrawal deletes all sessions, trials and reflections and invalidates the secret.

consents.description: Which consent text (hash) was accepted under which ethics reference and when. Retained after withdrawal as a minimal governance record.

experiment_sessions.description: Coarse category from viewport size and touch support; no user-agent string is stored.
Mode actually used for the visual-search task (fallbacks are recorded, never hidden).
Whether the camera backdrop was active. No image or video is ever captured, stored or uploaded.
complexity 0-2 (6/18/36 items), movement, distraction (2 Hz low-contrast flicker), brightness 0.2-1.0, block_modalities (visual/audiovisual per block).
pre_stress, post_stress (single-item self-report), perceived_difficulty, six NASA-TLX items (performance: 0 = perfect, 100 = failure). Raw TLX = mean of six.
median_frame_ms (display refresh estimate in 3D modes) and viewport size, for timing-quality screening.
Optional free text (max 4000 chars); participants are asked not to include identifiers. Visible to researchers only.

trials.description: visual_search, auditory_oddball, task_switching, flanker, pattern, arithmetic.
oddball: standard|deviant; task switching: first|repeat|switch; flanker: congruent|incongruent; pattern: progression|alternation|cycle.
visual, audiovisual (tone at target onset; only if actually delivered), auditory, none.
visual search: items on screen and target side; other tasks: stimulus descriptor (e.g. 'colour:cyan-circle').
Participant response and correctness (null for timeouts). Oddball: response 'press' or null; correct also covers correct rejections.
Time from the first painted frame showing the stimulus (performance.now) to the input event timestamp. Includes display and input latency that varies by device.
Stimulus onset as epoch milliseconds (timeOrigin + performance.now).
No response in the window / RT below 150 ms (100 ms for tones); anticipatory trials are excluded from RT summaries.

derived_session_metrics.description: Visual-search mean RT of correct non-anticipatory trials, coefficient of variation, and accuracy (timeouts count as incorrect).
Oddball signal-detection sensitivity d' (log-linear corrected), hit and false-alarm rates.
Task-switching cost: switch minus repeat RT (ms); repeat minus switch accuracy.
Flanker effect: incongruent minus congruent RT; congruent minus incongruent accuracy.
Raw NASA-TLX (mean of six items) and post minus pre stress.
